claims.text: The deep learning methods investigated for hate speech detection include FastText, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTMs).
Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) were also utilized in the study, showing significant performance improvements.
The best performing method was identified as 'LSTM + Random Embedding + GBDT'.
